visible_surface_condition: Smooth, flat, clean, nonporous printed packaging surface
evidence_used: Object image showing a rectangular cardboard product box labeled 'Mold Release Spray' with flat, smooth, parallel sides suitable for gecko pads.
Gripper embodiment description stating gecko dry adhesive performs best on clean, dry, smooth, nonporous surfaces.
calculation_summary: Estimated a baseline normal force appropriate for a lightweight object (~120ml package) grasped with high-adhesion gecko pads: F_normal = F_base_min + adjustment_for_light_box = 0.5 N + 0.7 N = 1.2 N.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: The box is assumed to be structurally rigid enough not to cave in under the applied normal force.
Mass is visually estimated from the labeled 120ml volume (~0.12 kg expected total weight).
Surface coating is assumed to be dry and free of oily residues despite the product name.
reasoning_trace: The target object is a rectangular paperboard box with flat, smooth, parallel sidewalls, making it an excellent candidate for the rigid gecko-adhesive gripper pads. Because the gecko pads provide strong dry adhesion on smooth, clean, nonporous surfaces, only a modest normal force is required to establish intimate contact and securely lift the lightweight object. Taking into account the visual scale (120ml volume) and optimal material compatibility, a low continuous normal force of 1.2 N is estimated as sufficient.
